verdict.rationale: The evidence lists plugin integrations (GitHub, Supabase, Figma) and broad agent capabilities such as shell access, but nothing documents a way for a lead to allow, restrict, or permission which tools and integrations the agent may use. BYOK provider configuration and diff review are adjacent controls (model routing and edit approval), not tool-access governance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
